heroSubtitle: Full-stack .NET developer in Chicago. I design and build ERP systems: data pipelines, integrations, reporting and the CI/CD behind them.
description: Full-stack .NET developer who turns sprawling enterprise systems into software people actually enjoy using. Blazor by trade, detail-obsessed by nature.
answer: I'm Doug Rosenberg, a Chicago-based full-stack .NET developer. I build Blazor and ERP systems for large organizations. I'm currently leading the full-stack build of an ERP system for a global nonprofit, with a secure data-masking pipeline for safe dev access, synced Salesforce and ERP records, and CI/CD for ten production apps. Before that I led UI/UX design and development across four applications at Tackle.ai.
